jobs.description:

Candidates must have steel toe boots, reliable transportation, and be at least 21 years old. Exceptional customer service and multitasking abilities are essential.

This role involves working in various weather conditions and standing for long periods. Ideal for those with experience in security, military, or related fields.

jobs.description:

The position emphasizes customer service, incident response, and patrols, with opportunities to grow into a full-time schedule while maintaining flexible hours and a supportive team environment.

jobs.description:

Applicants must be at least 21 years old, have reliable transportation, and possess customer service skills. The position requires standing for long periods and working in varying weather conditions. Great pay and benefits including health insurance and a 401(k) are offered.
